A more compact layout

Sentrix

A multi-branch storefront and staff back office for a security and surveillance retailer. Branch-scoped inventory and pricing follow each order from catalogue to checkout, with staff access enforced by role and record.

Forkcast

A mobile-first nutrition tracker that scans a meal photo, estimates foods and portions, and adds editable calories and macros to the daily log. The camera flow falls back to photo upload, and the AI scan can move across three providers when one fails.

Arawan

A mobile-first loan tracker for managing borrowers, payment schedules, and daily collections. Its overview surfaces what is due and collected, while the ledger preserves corrections as reversals and reconciles opening balances.

Tindahan

A mobile-first point-of-sale PWA for a small sari-sari store. Record sales in a few taps, track profit and stock, complete weekly inventory counts, and move inventory data through Excel.

My Notes

A personal notes board built on Laravel and Livewire. UUID-based records and server-side policies keep each note private, while live search and a deliberate delete flow make everyday editing feel quick.

Arawan captures use synthetic browser responses; no dummy loan or borrower records were saved. Sentrix and Forkcast images are the existing project captures.
